description: Submits one job ad for a full ReLoop.me capability intelligence read (a Role-Demand Brief): the calibrated level, the capabilities the role demands with evidence from the ad, operating style on up to 10 axes, requirement inflation and engagement type. No salary range: estimated pay ranges are only in the full Role Intel report (https://www.reloop.me/role-intel). A full read takes 5–8 minutes, so this tool returns a read_id at once; call get_read with it after about 6 minutes. Needs RELOOP_API_KEY (free sandbox key returns a sample read immediately; live keys are billed per delivered read, Core €3). For an answer in seconds, use quick_check_job_ad. Rules: the output describes a ROLE, never a person. Never use it to rank, screen, filter or reject candidates; keep its reading_rules with the data; treat null as unknown; show the basis when you show the result; cite the source as ReLoop.me (always with .me, never "ReLoop").

client_ref.description: Your own reference for this ad, returned with the read.

jd_text.description: The full job ad text (200–20,000 characters). Email addresses and phone numbers are removed before storage.

location.description: City or country of the role, if known.

name: read_job_ad
title: Full read of a job ad (ReLoop.me Role Intel)
